  - main:
    - article:
      - heading "3D CUBE DECOMPOSITION MODEL" [level=2]
      - button "(a + b)³"
      - button "(a − b)³"
      - text: Labels
      - checkbox "Labels" [checked]
      - img "Cubic identity volume decomposition": a + b a b a + b
      - text: a³ a²b ab² b³
      - paragraph: "Total volume: (a + b)³"
    - article:
      - heading "ALGEBRA TILES (drag to cube)" [level=2]
      - button "a³ ×1"
      - button "a²b ×3"
      - button "ab² ×3"
      - button "b³ ×1"
      - heading "SYMBOLIC EXPANSION CONTROLS" [level=2]
      - button "Expand"
      - button "Collapse"
      - button "Randomize"
      - button "Reset":
        - img
        - text: Reset
      - text: (a + b)³ = a³ + 3a²b + 3ab² + b³ Term volumes a³ 3a²b 3ab² b³ Numeric check a =
      - spinbutton "Value a": "2"
      - text: b =
      - spinbutton "Value b": "1"
      - button "Compute"
      - text: Left side (a + b)³
      - strong: "27"
      - text: = Right side sum
      - strong: 8 +12 +6 +1 = 27
      - img
      - text: Identity verified! LHS = RHS = 27
    - article:
      - heading "WHY IT WORKS" [level=2]:
        - img
        - text: WHY IT WORKS
      - paragraph: "The cube of side (a+b) is partitioned into four non-overlapping parts:"
      - list:
        - listitem: a³ — one large cube.
        - listitem: 3a²b — three faces of size a × a × b.
        - listitem: 3ab² — three faces of size a × b × b.
        - listitem: b³ — one small cube.
      - text: Adding their volumes gives (a+b)³.
    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=2]:
        - img
        - text: WORKED EXAMPLE
      - paragraph: For a=2, b=1
      - strong: (a+b)³=(2+1)³=3³=27
      - text: "Breakdown:"
      - paragraph: 🟦 a³ = 2³ = 8
      - paragraph: 🟩 3a²b = 3·2²·1 = 12
      - paragraph: 🟪 3ab² = 3·2·1² = 6
      - paragraph: 🟧 b³ = 1³ = 1
      - text: 8 + 12 + 6 + 1 = 27 ✓
    - article:
      - heading "MISCONCEPTION WARNING" [level=2]:
        - img
        - text: MISCONCEPTION WARNING
      - text: Do not omit the coefficients 3.
      - paragraph: They come from the three congruent rectangular prisms of each type.
      - text: ×3 = Ignoring the 3 undercounts the volume and breaks the identity.
    - 'heading "CHALLENGE: (a − b)³" [level=2]'
    - paragraph: Assemble the pieces and match every signed term.
